title: dicksonia cicutaria var. incisa
intro: Dicksonia cicutaria var. incisa, commonly known as the mountain silver fern or silver fern, is a species of fern native to New Zealand. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, among others, exerting anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of Dicksonia cicutaria var. incisa have been shown to possess potential therapeutic applications in wound healing, skin care, and anti-aging treatments.
